```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/atus.duckdb")

dbplyr_act <- tbl(con, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(con, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(con, "activity_codes")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

activity_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(
    employment_status == "Not in labor force",
    day_type == "Weekday"
  ) |>
  select(tucaseid, sex) |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  left_join(
    dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name),
    by = "activity_code"
  ) |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, major_name) |>
  summarise(
    total_minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  group_by(sex, major_name) |>
  summarise(
    mean_minutes = mean(total_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(sex, desc(mean_minutes))
```

```{r}
hourly_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(
    employment_status == "Not in labor force",
    day_type == "Weekday"
  ) |>
  select(tucaseid, sex) |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_codes |>
      filter(major_code %in% c("01", "02", "03", "12")) |>
      select(activity_code, major_name),
    by = "activity_code"
  ) |>
  mutate(hour = as.integer(start_hhmm / 100)) |>
  filter(hour >= 6, hour <= 23) |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, major_name, hour) |>
  summarise(
    total_minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  group_by(sex, major_name, hour) |>
  summarise(
    mean_minutes = mean(total_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(sex, major_name, hour)

print(hourly_avg, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(major_name, mean_minutes),
    y = mean_minutes,
    fill = sex
  )) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "How Americans Spend Their Weekdays",
    subtitle = "Average daily minutes by activity and sex among people not in the labor force",
    x = "Activity Category",
    y = "Average Minutes per Day",
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
hourly_avg |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = hour,
    y = mean_minutes,
    fill = major_name
  )) +
  geom_area(position = "stack", alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~sex, ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(6, 23, by = 2),
    labels = function(x) {
      ifelse(
        x < 12,
        paste0(x, " AM"),
        ifelse(
          x == 12,
          "12 PM",
          paste0(x - 12, " PM")
        )
      )
    }
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "How Americans Spend Their Day",
    subtitle = "Average minutes spent in activities starting each hour, by sex",
    x = "Time of Day",
    y = "Average Minutes",
    fill = "Activity Category",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )
```
